items.title: Commercial LPG Prices Cut by ₹209 per Cylinder
items.whyInNews: The price of commercial LPG cylinders has been reduced by ₹209 per cylinder, effective from August 1, 2026. This reduction will affect the prices of 19 kg commercial cylinders in various cities across India.
items.summary: The reduction in commercial LPG prices will lead to a decrease in the cost of living for businesses and industries that rely on LPG for their operations. A 19 kg commercial cylinder will now cost ₹2,872.50 in Kolkata. The prices of domestic LPG cylinders remain unchanged. This move is expected to have a positive impact on the economy, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises.

Effective date of price reduction: August 1, 2026
New price of 19 kg commercial cylinder in Kolkata: ₹2,872.50
No change in prices of domestic LPG cylinders
importantPoints: Full form of LPG: Liquefied Petroleum Gas
Related government scheme: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) Act, 2006
Historical context: Previous price reduction was in 2022, when the price of commercial LPG was reduced by ₹102 per cylinder
Key statistic: India is the third-largest consumer of LPG in the world, with a total consumption of 24.9 million tonnes in 2020-21
Policy implication: The price reduction is expected to boost the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises, which are significant contributors to India's GDP

items.title: Polavaram Irrigation Project: 189 Villages Affected by Sabari and Godavari Floods
items.whyInNews: The Sabari and Godavari floods have affected at least 189 villages in the submergence area of the Polavaram irrigation project in Polavaram district. The floods have also threatened the submergence of 32 Konaseema islands.
items.summary: The Polavaram irrigation project is a major irrigation project located in the state of Andhra Pradesh. The project aims to provide irrigation facilities to the farmers of the region and also generate hydroelectric power. The floods in the Sabari and Godavari rivers have caused significant damage to the crops and properties of the people living in the affected areas. The government has announced relief measures to support the affected people.

Number of Konaseema islands threatened by submergence: 32

Purpose of the Polavaram irrigation project: Irrigation and hydroelectric power generation
importantPoints: Full form of the project: Polavaram Irrigation Project
Related government scheme: Andhra Pradesh Irrigation and CAD Department
Historical context: The project was first proposed in 1941, but the construction work began in 2004
Key statistic: The project is expected to irrigate an area of 2.91 lakh hectares and generate 960 MW of hydroelectric power
Policy implication: The project is expected to have a significant impact on the agricultural sector and the economy of Andhra Pradesh

items.title: National Human Rights Commission Takes Suo Motu Cognizance of Malaria Deaths in Chhattisgarh
items.whyInNews: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance of the deaths of five people due to malaria in Chhattisgarh's Kanker district, marking a significant development in the field of human rights and health.
items.summary: The NHRC has issued a notice to the Chhattisgarh government, seeking a detailed report on the deaths and the steps taken to prevent such incidents in the future.
